name: ITAB Group AB (publ)
summary: ITAB Group AB (publ) develops, manufactures, sells, and installs store concepts for retail chain stores. The company provides solution design, customized shop fittings, checkouts, consumer flow solutions, professional lighting systems, light planning, audio systems and energy reduction service and digitally interactive solutions for the physical stores. It offers checkouts and self-service systems; click and collect, an automated and convenient online delivery option; consumer and colleague safety systems; consumer interaction systems; security gates for entrance and exit; queue management systems; standard fittings and accessories; and retail lighting products.
